message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients you’ll need:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9 × 13 in. pan) |
|----------|------------|---------------------------------------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | Dry lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | • Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1 ½ lb (680 g) |
| | • Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | • Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | • Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | • Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | • Olive oil | 1 Tbsp |
| | • Salt, pepper, oregano, basil, red‑pepper flakes | to taste |
| | • Optional: red wine, bay leaf, carrot & celery (finely diced) | ¼ cup wine, 1 bay leaf, ½ cup carrot & celery |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (beaten) | 1 |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Fresh parsley or basil, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt & pepper | to taste |
| **Bechamel (optional)** | Butter | 4 Tbsp |
| | All‑purpose flour | 4 Tbsp |
| | Milk | 4 cups (1 L) |
| | Nutmeg, salt, pepper | pinch |
| **Cheese topping** | Shredded mozzarella | 2 cups (200 g) |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Optional: shredded provolone or fontina | ½ cup |

### Quick Steps
1. **Cook the noodles** (if not no‑boil) until al dente, drain, and lay flat on a sheet of parchment.
2. **Make the meat sauce**: sauté onion, garlic, and optional veggies; add ground meat until browned; stir in tomatoes, paste, wine, herbs, and simmer 20–30 min.
3. **Prepare ricotta mix**: combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, herbs, salt, and pepper.
4. **Optional bechamel**: melt butter, whisk in flour, gradually add milk, cook until thickened, season.
5. **Layer**: start with a thin layer of sauce, then noodles, ricotta mixture, sauce, and a sprinkle of mozzarella. Repeat until all layers are used, finishing with mozzarella and Parmesan on top.
6. **Bake**: cover with foil (to prevent sticking, spray foil with cooking spray), bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25 min, then remove foil and bake another 10–15 min until bubbly and golden.
7. **Rest**: let sit 10–15 min before slicing.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
